questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Kei or Warriors?
At St George's Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?

questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Rhinos on 2024/04/06.

questions.question: Which of these players was the youngest to debut for the South Africa Open Ladies indoor cricket team?
questions.explanation: Kapp made her debut at 16 years, 9 months, 5 days for South Africa Open Ladies indoor cricket in 2006.

questions.question: Nuraan Pipers set a database record (08/09 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 16. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Maidens', held by Nuraan Pipers.

questions.question: At which ground did Titans record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 421, against Limpopo Lillies on 2011/02/27.
